prompt:
Educational flat-design concept map — mind map illustration, square 1:1 format. Italian middle school textbook (scuola secondaria I grado), DigComp I level. Central hub: large rounded rectangle "🏗️ Città, servizi urbani e pianificazione", solid fill #BF360C, white bold sans-serif label, subtle drop shadow. Five branch clusters radiate from the hub with smooth curved lines. Each branch has a colored pill label and 2–5 smaller rounded child nodes:
  • INNESCA [#5E35B1]: "Città, servizi urbani e pianificazione"
  • ESPLORA [#1565C0]: "Lo studente analizza l'organizzazione urbana e…" | "zone residenziali" | "commerciali" | "industriali"
  • SPERIMENTA [#E65100]: "piano regolatore / urban master plan" | "zoning / zoning"
  • AGISCI [#00695C]: "Analizza il quartiere della scuola" | "usando Google Maps, identifica le zone funzionali, conta…" | "Professione futura: Urban Planner Sostenibile"
  • RIPASSA [#F57F17]: "città" | "urbanistica" | "servizi urbani" | "quartiere" | "piano regolatore"
Style rules: white background, all labels in Italian, branch nodes solid fill (branch color) with white text, hub accent stripe #BF360C on bottom edge only, connecting lines 2px curved matching branch color, no photographs, no decorative frames, no gradients, clean radial balanced layout, Inter/Nunito-style sans-serif typography, WCAG AA contrast, flat vector illustration, 1:1 square.
